hero.heading: Build the Future of AI Writing
hero.subtitle: Join a small, ambitious team reshaping how the world writes. We're looking for passionate people who want to push the boundaries of AI and creativity.

mission.title: Mission-Driven
mission.description: Work on AI that empowers every writer. Your code will directly impact how millions of people create and communicate.

impact.title: Small Team, Big Impact
impact.description: No bureaucracy, no red tape. Your ideas ship fast, your contributions are visible, and every team member shapes the product.

remote.title: Remote-Friendly
remote.description: Work from anywhere in the world. We're async-first with flexible hours, so you can do your best work on your own schedule.

positions.label: Careers
positions.title: Open Positions
positions.subtitle: Find your next role and help us build something extraordinary.

marketing.title: Marketing Lead
marketing.description: Drive doXmind's growth strategy across channels. You'll own brand positioning, content marketing, and user acquisition to bring our AI writing platform to a global audience.

sales.title: Sales Lead
sales.description: Build and lead our sales motion from the ground up. You'll develop enterprise relationships, shape our go-to-market strategy, and close deals that expand doXmind's reach.

ml.title: ML Engineer
ml.description: Design and optimize the machine learning systems powering doXmind's AI features. You'll work on multi-agent architectures, fine-tuning, and building intelligent writing assistance at scale.

culture.label: Perks & Benefits
culture.title: How We Work
culture.subtitle: We believe great work comes from great environments. Here's what you'll enjoy.

flexibility.title: Flexible Schedule
flexibility.description: Async-first culture with flexible hours. Work when you're most productive — early bird or night owl, we've got you.

growth.title: Rapid Growth
growth.description: Join at an early stage where your career trajectory is steep. Take ownership of major initiatives and grow with the company.

equity.title: Equity Package
equity.description: Every team member shares in our success. Competitive salary plus meaningful equity so you benefit from what we build together.

tools.title: Best-in-Class Tools
tools.description: Top-tier hardware, any software you need, and a home office stipend. We invest in what makes you productive.

cta.heading: Ready to Shape the Future?
cta.subtitle: We're building something extraordinary. If you're excited about AI and writing, we'd love to hear from you.
